presentation_and_claim_rules.rule: Displayed rounding alone determines tolerance; full source values remain in CSV/JSON. No n=9 descriptor uncertainty is inferred from decimal precision.
Saved numeric arithmetic and audit receipt checks do not rerun model fitting, checkpoint inference, raw EEG spectral analysis, or new statistical hypotheses.

limitations: Table 1 dimensional/population metadata checks use archived source/method receipts; Table 2/3 protocol comparison statements are qualitative inspections, not newly replayed training histories.
Figure source-array/caption semantics, receipt hashes and artifact existence inspected; page layout and pixels are delegated to separate visual QA.
Raw central-channel spectral replay and historical prediction recomputation remain the explicitly scoped archived independent validation, not new work in this review.
